description: Send a friend request to another user by user_id, or by email. This emails a real person, so ALWAYS confirm the recipient with the user before calling, and pass confirmed=true only once they agree. Provide exactly one of user_id or email. If the email belongs to someone not on Tineo, an invitation to join is sent instead. For privacy, the email path always reports the same neutral result whether or not the address is registered.

confirmed.description: Must be true. Set only after the user has confirmed they want to send this request/invite.

email.description: Target email address. Provide this OR user_id, not both.

user_id.description: Target user id (e.g. from friends_list or a suggestion). Provide this OR email, not both.

name: friend_request_send
title: Send Friend Request
